lessons.title: -지 않다 / -지 못하다
lessons.learn: Formal negation! 먹지 않아요 (I don't eat — formal), 가지 않아요. CAN'T: 먹지 못해요 (I can't eat / unable). 안 = casual, -지 않다 = formal writing and speeches. Reason: 왜냐하면…그래서!

grammar.title: -지 않다 (won't) · -지 못하다 (can't)
grammar.explain: 안 먹어요 = don't eat (casual), 먹지 않아요 = don't eat (formal). 먹지 못해요 = CAN'T eat (unable). 못 = unable, 안 = unwilling!

examples.en: I can't go. I'm unable to go.
Because I'm sick. So I rest.

mistakes: Using -지 않다 with friends — friends: 안!
Saying 안 못 가요 — pick ONE: 못 가요!

dialogue.en: Sorry, I'm sick so I can't eat.

lessons.title: Can and plan: -(으)ㄹ 수 / -(으)려고
lessons.learn: Ability! -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요 (can): 할 수 있어요, 먹을 수 있어요. Can't: 수 없어요. Plans: -(으)려고 해요 (I plan to): 가려고 해요! Ability + plans = B1 power!

grammar.title: -(으)ㄹ 수 있어요 · -(으)려고
grammar.explain: 할 수 있어요 (can do), 할 수 없어요 (can't). Vowel-stems: 갈 수, consonant: 먹을 수! Plans: 한국에 가려고 해요 (I plan to go to Korea)!

examples.en: I plan to go to Korea!

mistakes: Saying 할 수 있다 politely — polite: 수 있어요!

dialogue.en: Amazing! What do you plan to do?

lessons.title: Family and 님 honorifics
lessons.learn: Family + respect! MY folks (humble): 아빠/엄마 fine at home. YOUR family (polite): 아버님, 어머님 (+님!). Elders get 세요 verbs: 드세요 (please eat, honorific)!

grammar.title: +님 and 세요 honorifics
grammar.explain: 부모님 (honored parents), 선생님 (honored teacher). Verbs: 드세요 (honorific eat), 계세요 (honorific be). Elevate ELDERS, humble YOURSELF with 저!
mistakes: Saying 엄마 to elders about YOUR mum — humble at home, polite outside!
Forgetting 님 for teachers: 선생님, not 선생!

dialogue.en: Four. Parents and me (and one more)!
Yes, I have an older brother! (m speaking)

lessons.title: Age: 몇 살
lessons.learn: Age: 몇 살이에요? (How old?) → 스무 살이에요 (I'm 20). 살 counts years with NATIVE numbers! Birthdays: 생일이 언제예요? → 삼월이에요! Months: 월, days: 일!

grammar.title: 살 (native age) · 월/일 dates
grammar.explain: 스무 살 (20), 열일곱 살 (17). Months SINO: 일월 (Jan), 삼월 (Mar). Days: 삼일 (3rd), 이십일 (21st)!
mistakes: Saying 이십 살 — 20 is 스무 살!

lessons.title: Opinions: -고 생각해요
lessons.learn: Think out loud! -고 생각해요 (I think that…): 지하철이 좋다고 생각해요! Compare: 더 (more), 제일 (most): 이게 제일 좋아요 = This is the best! 보다 = than!

grammar.title: -고 생각해요 + 더/제일 + 보다
grammar.explain: 지하철이 좋다고 생각해요 (I think the subway is good). 더 커요 (bigger), 제일 좋아요 (best). 차보다 커요 = bigger THAN the car!

examples.en: I think the subway is good.

mistakes: Saying 좋아요고 생각해요 — quote: 좋다고 생각해요!

dialogue.en: I think the subway is good.

grammar.title: 비가 와요 · 추웠어요
